name: Inspiration Inbox / New Horizons monthly AI round-up (Notion)

how_to_use: Open the Notion database.

name: Generative AI – General Guidelines (Legal)
summary: Legal guidelines for using AI in creative work: follow tool ToS; prompts may become public so don't copy prompts or include client names/products/brands/people; no images of public figures; check originality (reverse image search); raw AI output isn't copyrightable so never deliver raw output — create a derivative work. If followed, AI may be used without informing the customer.
how_to_use: Questions: tag the Legal group in Slack.

name: Recommended GenAI tools for early-stage work (2022)
summary: Initial recommendations when the channel opened: Midjourney (detailed/costlier) and DALL-E 2 (cheaper) for storyboards/concepts, Copy.ai for placeholder copy, Mubert for animatic music, Typecast for VO, thispersondoesnotexist for placeholder avatars.
